decisions.statement: An info line goes to the chat window where no log viewer is loaded.
A line other than info is written only while logging is on.
An info line is written whether logging is on or off.
A table already written out is named rather than written out again.
A first value holding a placeholder takes the values after it as its fillings.
Whether a log viewer is loaded is read once, as an add-on's log is made.
A log viewer loading after that read is not seen.

definition: the log line written for each value an add-on hands over
